subject.title: fix(infra): clarify Allow Always unavailable message for one-shot commands

question: Should maintainers repair this PR into the canonical fix, or choose a different overlapping PR for the redirected-command Allow Always wording bug?
rationale: Multiple open PRs target the same canonical issue, this branch is currently conflicting and has blocking code/test defects, and automation should not choose the approval-surface landing branch without maintainer intent.

options.title: Repair this branch first
options.body: Keep this PR as a candidate only after it restores node pending state, fixes the duplicate test declaration, covers Control UI, resolves conflicts, and adds current-head proof.

options.title: Promote an overlapping PR
options.body: Use a sibling PR as canonical only after it is updated, mergeable, proof-positive, and verified to cover the same full approval surface.

options.title: Pause duplicate branches
options.body: Hold or close duplicate branches after an approval-area owner chooses the implementation shape and preserves any useful test/proof evidence.

recommendation.title: Repair this branch first
recommendation.body: Keep this PR as a candidate only after it restores node pending state, fixes the duplicate test declaration, covers Control UI, resolves conflicts, and adds current-head proof.
